# Loadout Rank

> Ranked AI tools by use case (8 categories, 10 tools each) plus a dated list of recent AI releases. Scores are provisional editorial seed scores as of 2026-10-22.

Key facts: updated 2026-10-22; weights planned Quality 40 / Adoption 20 / Value 15 / Ease 15 / Trust 10; no affiliate or sponsored links currently.

## Main
- [Rankings (Markdown, citable)](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/rankings.md): all rankings, scores, release list with dates and sources
- [Rankings (HTML)](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/): same data with per-category anchors
- [Methodology & disclosure](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/about.html)
- [Head-to-head comparisons index](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/comparisons.html)
- [Full text for LLMs](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/llms-full.txt): every ranking, the release list, and each comparison's verdict, pick-if guidance, price/feature table and sources in one Markdown file
